Operating Systems: Memory management allocates and deallocates memory to processes as needed. Virtual memory extends physical RAM by using disk storage as additional memory. File systems organize data storage on physical devices like hard drives and SSDs. Multithreading allows multiple threads of execution within a single process. Process management involves scheduling and coordinating multiple running programs.
